text:
Anya: Tiny Plush Council forming. Bring a photo + name of your desk plush. Winner is official office mascot for the week. Voting by emoji 👍 until 5pm. I'll start: meet Mochi (image attached). :pleading_face:

Kai: Mochi is commanding. I nominate Captain Button (sock penguin) 🐧 — he has a tiny button eye.

Ravi: Hearted Mochi. Also proposing tiny inauguration music.

Sofia: Sprocket (robot keycap) here. Tiny but ferocious :robot_face:

Elena: I can't pick. Mochi is a vibe, Captain Button is chaotic, Sprocket is stealthy. Poll imminent :raised_hands:

Tessa: My cactus is flattered to be considered but it's not plush 😅 :cactus:

plush-bot: Poll created — react with :heart: for Mochi, :star: for Captain Button, :zap: for Sprocket. Poll ends 17:00 today.

Zane: Hearted Mochi. Also formally proposing an investiture ceremony with a tiny crown. :crown:

Kai: if Mochi wins, can we get a "Mochi Monday" custom status? I will wear socks with tiny alpacas. :joy:

Anya: Winner announced at 5. Crown on standby (I have stickers). Tiny oath suggestion: 'I pledge snacks and desk-space respect' — who wants to write the prologue?

Ravi: I'll draft it. Preliminary: 'By the power invested in us by the snack drawer and the sacred coffee machine, we honor the Tiny Plush Council and pledge to protect nap-time dignity.' Thoughts?

Sofia: perfect. low stakes, high morale :thumbsup:

Tessa: Poll closed. Quick tally from reactions: Mochi ❤️ x5, Captain Button ⭐ x3, Sprocket ⚡ x2.

plush-bot: Mochi is the new Tiny Plush Council Mascot! :confetti_ball: Congratulations Mochi.

Anya: Investiture scheduled 15:00 in the kitchen. Bring cookies if you can. Mochi crown assembly party — stickers and glue provided. Photo ops mandatory. :camera_with_flash:
